translations.answer: Maintainer determines that the JointModelComposite was not officially supported for derivatives at the time, suggesting to use pure JointModelFreeFlyer and define disturbances in the tangent space using integrate/difference. A reference to the official C++ CasADi RNEA derivative test is provided. However, the original author did not provide a comparison after switching to FreeFlyer, and no answer was given regarding the error-state/Euler/quaternion optimization variables. Therefore, this is not a verified fix and can only serve as a diagnostic path for the target version and joint model.
translations.applicability: Applies to Pinocchio 3, CasADi RNEA derivatives, and Composite/FreeFlyer root joints. Current Composite state needs re-validation.
translations.credibility.rationale: No reproducible records have been formed.
translations.details.attempts.0: Original author compared Pinocchio's dtau_dq with CasADi's q-Jacobian using the same q, v, a.
translations.details.attempts.1: Maintainer suggests using pure FreeFlyer and integrate/difference in the tangent space, with a link to the official C++ CasADi derivative test.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: First check if the root joint is JointModelComposite and if the target algorithm officially supports it.
translations.details.diagnostics.1: Use integrate/difference in the tangent space for FreeFlyer configuration; do not assume ordinary derivatives of Euler angles or quaternions are equivalent to tangent space derivatives.
translations.details.diagnostics.2: Reference the fixed C++ unit test to establish the same joint model and disturbance definition.
translations.details.environments.0: Pinocchio 3 Python, pin.buildSampleModelHumanoidRandom(False), CasADi SX; original post did not provide OS, CasADi/Pinocchio exact versions or commit.
translations.details.limits.0: Maintainer's judgment is that the original author did not re-test or link the fix; this can only serve as a high-value diagnostic direction.
translations.details.limits.1: No answer was given regarding the error state, Euler angle, and quaternion optimization variables; this card does not provide an optimizer design itself.
translations.details.limits.2: The linked unit test shows the official usage, but does not prove that the original author's Composite Joint model is supported.
translations.details.outcomes.0: No results from the thread switched to FreeFlyer; no answer given on how to parameterize the optimization variables; Issue closed does not prove the difference has vanished in the original environment.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: CasADi's q-Jacobian and Pinocchio's dtau_dq are inconsistent in floating base space; how should the Composite Joint and configuration manifold be handled?
translations.details.safety_notes.0: Check for finite difference/automatic differentiation before derivatives enter the optimizer; floating base space inconsistency precludes direct use in real-time torque optimization.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: Maintainer's judgment is that JointModelComposite was not officially supported for derivatives at the time.
translations.details.symptoms.0: The dtau_dq from Pinocchio and CasADi's q-Jacobian are identical in the non-root joint columns, but there is a significant difference in the floating base columns.
translations.details.symptoms.1: Original author was concerned about the difference affecting optimization.
translations.source.locator: Pinocchio #1872 comment 1436459057 determines Composite derivatives not supported and suggests FreeFlyer/integrate/difference; comment 1436461285 links to fixed unit test; comment 1439410356 fails to answer optimization variable question.
